title: Clean Standard audit with honest degradation reporting
code_snippet:
$ git status --porcelain go.mod go.sum   # (empty)
$ go mod verify
all modules verified
$ govulncheck ./... ; echo rc=$?
No vulnerabilities found.
rc=0
$ go-licenses check ./... --disallowed_types=forbidden,unknown ; echo rc=$?
rc=0
$ go env GOPROXY GOPRIVATE GOSUMDB
https://proxy.golang.org,direct
github.com/company/*
sum.golang.org
$ git status --porcelain go.mod go.sum   # (still empty)
expected_feedback: No violations. The scan completed (rc=0), so 'No vulnerabilities found.' is a supportable claim; the worktree is byte-identical before and after, proving the audit was read-only; licence policy is stated rather than implied; and real go env values are reported instead of assumed.
